title: Realization preserves homotopy equivalences of Reedy-cofibrant simplicial objects
statement:
Use simplicial model categories as defined in [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization], simplicial tensors of [def-coef-simplicial-tensor-cotensor], the Reedy model structure of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure], and combinatorial simplicial homotopies as explicitly defined in [lem-coef-simplicial-extra-degeneracy-prism]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a simplicial model category, and let $A_\bullet,B_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal M$ be Reedy-cofibrant simplicial objects. Define the tensor realization of any simplicial object $C_\bullet$ by
$$|C_\bullet|=\operatorname{coeq}\left(\coprod_{\alpha:[m]\to[n]}C_n\otimes\Delta^m\rightrightarrows\coprod_{n\geq0}C_n\otimes\Delta^n\right),$$
where $\Delta^n=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta(-,[n])$ and the arrows are induced respectively by $C(\alpha)$ and $\Delta^\alpha$. Suppose $f:A_\bullet\to B_\bullet$ has a map $g:B_\bullet\to A_\bullet$, a combinatorial simplicial homotopy connecting $gf$ and $1_A$, and a combinatorial simplicial homotopy connecting $fg$ and $1_B$, each in either orientation. Then $|f|:|A_\bullet|\to|B_\bullet|$ is a weak equivalence in $\mathcal M$. No fibrancy hypothesis is imposed. Here a combinatorial simplicial homotopy consists of degree-raising prism maps; it does not mean a degreewise family $A_n\otimes\Delta^1\to B_n$.

source.place: Dugger, A Primer on Homotopy Colimits, coend realization (3.2), skeletal pushout in the proof of Theorem 3.5 (printed pp.9-10), and simplicial tensor/SM7 in Section 19.1 (printed p.90); the explicit general combinatorial-homotopy formulation and its proof are supplied by the second reader in report.md, not asserted to be a verbatim numbered theorem of Dugger. No Stacks tag states this result.
